በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
ዘእነግረክሙ: ነገረ — that which I tell you (ዘ- relative + G 1cs imperf. with suffix 2mp -ክሙ)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ሙ: ሙ — -ሙ, detached pronominal suffix; it completes the preceding እምኔክ as እምኔክሙ 'from you (pl.)' (suffix, 2mp)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘይትዐደው: ተዐደወ — who transgresses (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
ወበምድር: ምድር — and on earth (ወ- + በ- + noun)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
ንሖር: ሖረ — let us go (1cp jussive, G)

ቅድስተ: ቅድስት — holy place, sanctuary (noun, fem.; construct 'holy of')
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
ወሰሎሞንሂ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon too (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሂ)
ምንባሪሃ: መንበር — her place of setting, her seat (noun, variant spelling ምንባር of መንበር, as in published ch. 29, + -ሃ '3fs her')

ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ላዕሌነ: ላዕለ — upon us (preposition, stem ላዕሌ- + -ነ '1cp us')
ተነሥተ: ተነሠተ — was taken away (3ms perfect, Gt stem, passive of ነሠተ 'take away, seize', as in ነሠትካ above; if from ነሥአ the spelling would be ተነሥአ) (?)
ዳግመ: ዳግም — again, a second time (adverb, accusative form in -a)
ለባዕዳን: ባዕድ — to strangers, foreigners (ለ- + plural ባዕዳን of ባዕድ 'other, strange')
አልዋሕ: ሊሕ — boards, planks (?) (plural አልዋሕ; singular and lemma uncertain) (?)
በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. በሰማያት: ሰማይ — in the heavens (በ- 'in' + plural noun)
ዘርእየ: ርእየ — what he saw (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ይሄሉ: ሀሎ — he will be, is present (3ms imperfect, h-l-w)
እግዚኣብሔርኒ: እግዚአብሔር — God also, indeed God (noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed')
እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
ወይኩን: ኮነ — and may it be (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, G, k-w-n)
እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
ኪዳነ: ኪዳን — covenant (noun, m.; construct 'covenant of') · accusative 'a covenant' as object (ሀበኒኬ ኪዳነ 'give me a covenant')
አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ለአበዊነ: አብ — to our fathers (ለ- + plural አበው, አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form)
አውሥእዎ: አውሥአ — they answered him (3mp perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ś-ʾ; + -ዎ 'him')
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ትኩን: ኮነ — that she be (3fs jussive) · that you be (2ms jussive, ከመ ትኩን ከማሁ 'that you be like him') · let it be (3fs jussive, ትኩን ሞትነ 'may our death be')
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ዘንትዐደው: ተዐደወ — that we transgress (ዘ- relative + tä-stem 1cp imperf., ʿ-d-w)
ለባዕድ: ባዕድ — to another, a strange one (ለ- + noun/adjective)
ተነሥአት: ተንሥአ — she rose (3fs perfect, n-ś-ʾ; subject ጽዮን)
ወሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon, indeed (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
ጥበቦ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem., accusative + -ኦ '3ms his')

ለወለተ: ወለት — of the daughter of (ለ- 'of, for' + noun, fem., construct 'daughter of')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
ስማ: ስም — her name (noun + -ኣ '3fs her', written ስማ)
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
ዘያበርህ: አብርሀ — which gives light, illumines (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative IV, b-r-h)
ሌሊተ: ሌሊት — night (noun, fem., accusative; adverbial 'by night')
ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
ወእብነ: እብን — and stone of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወየሐውር: ሖረ — and he goes (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
ወይእቲሰ: ይእቲ — and she, as for her (ወ- + fem. pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
ጣዖታተ: ጣዖት — idols (noun; plural ጣዖታት, accusative form)
ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix) · which he gave it (feminine object, the city: ሀገር ዘወሀባ ሰሎሞን)
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ትሠውዕ: ሠውዐ — you sacrifice (2ms imperfect, G, ś-w-ʿ)
ተምዕዖ: ተምዕዐ — he was angry at him (3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him', Gt, m-ʿ-ʿ) (?)
ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-) · plain 'his wisdom' with no ለ- phrase following (ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወይሰግዱ: ሰገደ — and they will bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, s-g-d)
ለጣዖት: ጣዖት — to idols (ለ- + noun, Greek loan)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ወኀብሩ: ኀብረ — and they united/agreed (root ḫ-b-r, 3pl) · 'and they joined (in)' with ምስሌሆሙ 'with them' (ch. 55)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ወአንስት: ብእሲት — and women (ወ- + plural አንስት of ብእሲት)
ወአእማቲሃ: አመት — and her maidservants (ወ- + plural አእማት + -ሃ '3fs her')
ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r)
ሰሚዐ: ሰምዐ — to hear, hearing (infinitive, G; infinitive absolute before ሰማዕከ, 'truly hear')
ያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — he loves (3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55)
ወይሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — and he hears (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53)
ገጽ: ገጽ — face (noun) · side, place (በ፩ ገጽ 'on one side, in one place')
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ኢይክል: ከህለ — none can (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ትፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — you wish, want (2ms imperfect, G, f-q-d)
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
